Done. All three functions are implemented and exported:

- **`clamp(n, min, max)`** in src/num.js — limits n to the range [min, max]
- **`formatBytes(n)`** in src/util.js — formats byte counts as human-readable strings (B, KB, MB, GB with one decimal place)
- **`slugify(title)`** in src/text.js — converts titles to URL-friendly slugs (lowercase, trim, spaces to dashes, non-alphanumeric stripped)
